prompt:
Write 4 SQL test cases that might expose logic bugs in duckdb 1.5.5.
Topic: set operations with ALL. Batch 2. Seed 0.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Work quickly: do not analyse the engine's source or
internals, and do not try to work out whether a case fails. A harness runs every case and decides.

Format:
{"prediction": "<one sentence: what you expect to find>",
 "cases": [{"setup": ["CREATE TABLE ...", "INSERT INTO ..."], "query": "SELECT ...", "predicate": null,
            "oracle": "<one of the oracles below>", "expect": "pass"}]}

Rules:
- setup is a list of CREATE TABLE / INSERT statements; query is one SELECT. No statement ends with a semicolon.
- oracle is one of: tlp, norec, plan_variant, index_presence, equivalent_query, version_differential, cross_dbms.
- tlp and norec need a predicate: a boolean expression without the WHERE keyword, and query must be exactly
  SELECT <columns> FROM <table or join>, with no WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT or set operation.
- For any other oracle, either put every filter inside query and set predicate to null (any SELECT shape),
  or give a predicate with a plain SELECT <columns> FROM <table or join>; the harness then runs
  <query> WHERE (<predicate>).
- expect is your guess, "pass" or "fail".
text: {"prediction": "I expect standard SQL ALL set-operation multiplicity and precedence semantics to hold.", "cases": [{"setup": ["CREATE TABLE t1(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1), (1), (1), (2), (2), (NULL), (NULL)", "CREATE TABLE t2(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1), (2), (2), (NULL), (3)"], "query": "SELECT a FROM t1 INTERSECT ALL SELECT a FROM t2 ORDER BY a", "predicate": null, "oracle": "version_differential", "expect": "pass"}, {"setup": ["CREATE TABLE t1(a INTEGER, b INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, NULL), (1, NULL), (1, 2), (2, 3), (2, 3), (2, 3), (3, 4)", "CREATE TABLE t2(a INTEGER, b INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, NULL), (2, 3), (3, 4), (3, 4), (NULL, NULL)"], "query": "SELECT a, b FROM t1 EXCEPT ALL SELECT a, b FROM t2 ORDER BY a, b", "predicate": null, "oracle": "version_differential", "expect": "pass"}, {"setup": ["CREATE TABLE t1(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1), (1), (2)", "CREATE TABLE t2(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1), (3)", "CREATE TABLE t3(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t3 VALUES (1), (2)"], "query": "SELECT a FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT a FROM t2 INTERSECT ALL SELECT a FROM t3 ORDER BY a", "predicate": null, "oracle": "version_differential", "expect": "pass"}, {"setup": ["CREATE TABLE t1(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1), (1), (2), (2), (3)", "CREATE TABLE t2(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1), (2)", "CREATE TABLE t3(a INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO t3 VALUES (1), (2), (2)"], "query": "SELECT a FROM t1 EXCEPT ALL SELECT a FROM t2 INTERSECT ALL SELECT a FROM t3 ORDER BY a", "predicate": null, "oracle": "version_differential", "expect": "pass"}]}
